reason: The supporting tissue has a space for the lining and vessels beneath it.
expectation: The covered lining will join the supporting tissue above its vessels.

effect: The protected inner wall is complete, and the new goal is to join it to the muscle wall. The picture also shows water crossing toward blood.
reaction: The water-recovery role makes the wall more interesting than just a barrier.
reason: The new goal directly names the inner wall and muscle wall as the next pair.
expectation: The inner wall will fit inside the muscular outer wall of the colon.

alternatives.reason: I could explore the separate fibre-processing goal first.

effect: The colon now has an inner lining and a muscle wall, and the new goal is to complete the digestive tract.
reaction: The picture makes it clear that the contents stay separate from the blood.
reason: The upper digestive tract ends beside the colon outline, so joining them should make the continuous tract.
expectation: The colon will connect to the end of the small intestine.

alternatives.reason: I could explore the separate fibre-processing goal first.

effect: The digestive tract is connected; the remaining goal is to see what microbes make from fibre.
reaction: The continuous food route and separate blood vessels are clear in the picture.
reason: The picture shows resident microbes among fibres in the wet food remainder, with smaller molecules leaving them.
expectation: The microbes will turn some fibre into smaller molecules.

effect: The microbes produced small fatty acids and gas from some fibre, completing the remaining goal; some fibre stayed unbroken.
reaction: I was surprised that the bacteria also produced gas.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile because it showed that the colon recovers water as well as separating its contents from blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the colon to the upper tract was straightforward, though it helped show the continuous food route.

surprise.text: The microbes made gas as well as small fatty acids, and did not break down all the fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained where the parts belonged and why.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how other body systems connect, although this chapter's combinations were mostly predictable.
